title: Wittig olefination Z-selectivity dataset with 119 molecular descriptors
description: Wittig olefination reactions with their Z-alkene selectivity and 119 numerical descriptors of the carbonyl component, the phosphorus ylide and the cis- and trans-oxaphosphetane intermediates. Two files share one descriptor block: 734 literature reactions and 233 reactions derived from CAS reaction records (967 in total).

files.source: Curated in this work from E. Vedejs, M. J. Peterson, "Stereochemistry and Mechanism in the Wittig Reaction", Topics in Stereochemistry, Vol. 21, Wiley, 1994, doi:10.1002/9780470147306.ch1.

metadata_columns.name: record_id
metadata_columns.description: Stable record identifier VP1994_T<table>_E<entry>_C<condition>, built from source_table, source_entry and condition_index.

metadata_columns.name: source_table
metadata_columns.description: Table number in Vedejs and Peterson (1994).

metadata_columns.name: source_entry
metadata_columns.description: Entry number within source_table.

metadata_columns.name: condition_index
metadata_columns.description: 1-based index distinguishing experimental conditions reported for the same source entry.

metadata_columns.name: z_selectivity_percent
metadata_columns.description: Z-alkene selectivity in percent, %Z = 100*Z/(Z+E); %E = 100 - value. The model target. Literature records: the Z selectivity reported by Vedejs and Peterson (1994).

metadata_columns.name: temperature_c
metadata_columns.description: Reaction temperature in degrees Celsius, as reported. Not a model feature.

metadata_columns.name: solvent_reported
metadata_columns.description: Solvent notation as transcribed from the source.

metadata_columns.name: solvent_standardized
metadata_columns.description: Standardized solvent label that groups equivalent notations (for example PhH for C6H6).

metadata_columns.name: solvent_smiles
metadata_columns.description: SMILES of the reported solvent system; components are '.'-separated and may include a reported additive. Not a model feature.

metadata_columns.name: aldehyde_smiles
metadata_columns.description: SMILES of the carbonyl component; the ald_* descriptors describe this molecule.

metadata_columns.name: ylide_smiles
metadata_columns.description: SMILES of the phosphorus ylide; the ylide_* descriptors describe this molecule.

metadata_columns.name: base_smiles
metadata_columns.missing: NA when no separate base is specified
metadata_columns.description: SMILES of the base. Not a model feature.

metadata_columns.name: in_situ
metadata_columns.description: True if the ylide is generated in situ. Not a model feature.

metadata_columns.name: rxn_smiles
metadata_columns.description: Unmapped reaction representation: the carbonyl component, ylide, base (if specified) and solvent components as reactants, and the cis- and trans-oxaphosphetane intermediates as products.

files.feature_columns: features (all 119, in order, after the metadata columns)

files.source: Reactions from publications and patents dated 2010–2015 sourced from the CAS Content Collection™ (CAS is a division of the American Chemical Society); curated in this work.

metadata_columns.name: record_id
metadata_columns.description: Stable record identifier assigned in this work (prefixes CAS_R and X48_; numbering is not contiguous). Not a CAS Registry Number or CAS reaction identifier.

metadata_columns.name: dataset_version
metadata_columns.description: Constant 'wittig_cas_f119'.

metadata_columns.name: source_dataset
metadata_columns.description: Constant 'cas': record derived from a CAS reaction record.

metadata_columns.name: z_selectivity_percent
metadata_columns.description: Z-alkene selectivity in percent, %Z = 100*Z/(Z+E); %E = 100 - value. The model target. CAS records: computed from the amounts of the Z and E alkene products recorded in the CAS reaction record, with the geometry assigned at the newly formed C=C bond, from the recorded isomer percentages or product yields; rounded to 0.1.

metadata_columns.name: rxn_smiles
metadata_columns.description: Atom-mapped reaction SMILES of the CAS reaction record (reactants>>product).

metadata_columns.name: aldehyde_smiles
metadata_columns.description: SMILES of the carbonyl component (aldehyde or ketone); the ald_* descriptors describe this molecule. Written as recorded; some strings keep explicit-hydrogen bracket atoms.

metadata_columns.name: ylide_smiles
metadata_columns.description: SMILES of the phosphorus ylide; the ylide_* descriptors describe this molecule.

metadata_columns.name: base_smiles
metadata_columns.missing: NA when no base is assigned
metadata_columns.description: SMILES of the base. Not a model feature.

metadata_columns.name: cis_opa_smiles
metadata_columns.description: SMILES of the cis-oxaphosphetane intermediate.

metadata_columns.name: trans_opa_smiles
metadata_columns.description: SMILES of the trans-oxaphosphetane intermediate.

metadata_columns.name: in_situ
metadata_columns.description: True if the ylide is generated in situ. Not a model feature.

metadata_columns.name: temperature_c
metadata_columns.missing: NA when no single numeric temperature is assigned
metadata_columns.description: Reaction temperature in degrees Celsius. Not a model feature. The recorded stage conditions are in cas_stage_conditions.

metadata_columns.name: cas_n_stages
metadata_columns.description: Number of stages in the CAS reaction record.

metadata_columns.name: cas_olefination_stage
metadata_columns.description: Stage in which the carbonyl component and the ylide (or its precursor) are combined: the last stage that introduces a reactant.

metadata_columns.name: cas_stage_conditions
metadata_columns.description: Conditions recorded by CAS for each stage (temperature, duration, pressure) as 'stN: ...'. Stages are separated by ' | ' and condition entries within a stage by '; '. 'a to b' is a range, 'x -> y' a temperature change, '-' none recorded.

metadata_columns.name: solvent_record_status
metadata_columns.description: Solvent recorded for the olefination stage: 'single', 'multiple' (two or more solvents), or 'no_solvent_recorded' (no reaction solvent in any stage of the CAS record: missing information, not evidence of solvent-free conditions).

metadata_columns.name: solvent_reported
metadata_columns.missing: NA when no solvent is recorded or the CAS substance has no name in the source data
metadata_columns.description: CAS substance name(s) of the olefination-stage solvent(s), '+'-separated in record order. CAS RN 1330-20-7 (xylene, mixture of isomers) has no name or structure in the source data.

metadata_columns.name: solvent_cas_rn
metadata_columns.missing: NA when no solvent is recorded
metadata_columns.description: CAS Registry Number of each olefination-stage solvent, ';'-separated in the same order.

metadata_columns.name: solvent_smiles
metadata_columns.missing: NA when no solvent is recorded or no single structure exists
metadata_columns.description: Structure of each olefination-stage solvent from the CAS substance record, '.'-separated in the same order.

metadata_columns.name: solvent_stage
metadata_columns.missing: NA when no solvent is recorded
metadata_columns.description: Stage of the recorded solvent entry (equal to cas_olefination_stage).

metadata_columns.name: solvent_other_stages
metadata_columns.missing: NA when no other stage lists a solvent
metadata_columns.description: Solvents listed for other stages, not counted as the reaction solvent: 'stN(window)' is an earlier stage (for example reagent preparation) and 'stN(post)' a later stage (for example heating in a new medium or an aqueous quench). Stages are separated by ' | '.

metadata_columns.name: cas_stage_trace
metadata_columns.description: Per-stage summary of the CAS record: 'stN(window|post): solv=...; reactants=<n>; reagents=...; catalysts=...', where '(window)' marks stages up to the olefination stage and '(post)' later stages. Stages are separated by ' | ', '-' means none listed, and '[number]' is a CAS substance without a name in the source data.

files.feature_columns: features (all 119, in order, after the metadata columns)

combined.rule: Concatenate the rows of both files. record_id is unique across them, and the descriptor columns have identical names and order.

target.definition: Z-alkene selectivity in percent, %Z = 100*Z/(Z+E); %E = 100 - value. The model target.

features.method: Single-molecule GFN2-xTB calculations (gas phase, neutral species). Electronic descriptors from morfeus XTB, dispersion and surface descriptors from morfeus Dispersion, steric descriptors from morfeus Sterimol, and free energies from the xTB thermochemistry. The full protocol is described in the Supporting Information.
features.not_features: Metadata columns are not model inputs: temperature, base, solvent labels and structures, the in-situ flag and the stage information are context only.
